regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract-style introduction, and SI availability line
regions.finding: Article identity and reaction class were inspected. The page states that Supporting Information is available, but source_mapping.json marks its association unestablished; no SI facts were imported.

Three generic arrows were classified separately: carbometallation overview, prior iodoalkane-quench/oxidative-dimerization context, and the current generic CF3 concept. None was treated as a uniquely specified current experiment.

regions.region: page 1 right-column initial-trial and optimization prose
regions.finding: The PdCl2/DMA/Togni II no-product trial, CuCl/L1/Togni II 38% result, and Togni I 17% NMR result were identified. The 38% result is merged with Table 1 entry 1 on page 2; prose-only catalyst/ligand observations map to their table rows.

unresolved: Generic Scheme 1 R groups and metal identities do not define unique structures or conditions.
The Pd and Togni I trials omit some scales, volumes, atmosphere/workup details, or analytical basis.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Scheme 2 and Togni reagent structures
regions.finding: Three initial conditions were accounted for: PdCl2/Togni II no product, CuCl/L1/Togni II 38% NMR (merged with Table 1 entry 1), and Togni I 17% NMR.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 rows 1-12 and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Twelve catalyst/ligand experiments were retained row-by-row with scale, copper/ligand quantities, CH3CN volume, argon, 70 °C, row time, 19F-NMR yield/basis, and the entry-12 31% recovery. Entry 10 is merged with identical Table 2 entry 1.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 rows 1-10 and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Ten solvent conditions were accounted for. The CH3CN/66% row is merged with Table 1 entry 10; row 4 preserves 0% together with the complicated-19F-spectrum qualification; row 10 preserves the 30 °C override.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Table 3 rows 1-12 and footnotes a-h
regions.finding: Twelve scope rows plus a distinct 6 mmol scale-up were retained. Temperature and catalyst/ligand loading overrides, isolated yields, 2c/2l purity qualifications, and the separate 80% versus 87% 2b runs are preserved. The image explicitly prints 9 mol Togni II in the scale-up footnote and the inconsistency is left unresolved.

unresolved: The Table 3 scale-up footnote's 9 mol Togni II conflicts with the stated substrate scale and cannot be corrected from the source.
Most table rows omit workup, purification, isolated masses, and complete structure confirmation.
All candidate scope structures remain machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 3 discussion and Figure 1 ORTEP of 2g
regions.finding: Narrative support for scope and the separate 1.13 g/87% 2b scale-up was linked to existing Table 3 records. The 2g ORTEP supports the reported structure but is not a reaction and does not mark the machine structure verified.
Distinct radical-trapping run retained: 2a not formed, 51% 1a recovered, and TEMPO-CF3 adduct 3 formed in 37% yield based on TEMPO after 6 h at 30 °C.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Scheme 4 equations (1)-(2) and adjacent negative-result prose
regions.finding: Three mechanistic-probe results were retained separately: Sa-1k (94% ee) to racemic 2k (55%, 0% ee), allenoate 4 no desired product with 82% recovery, and the partially specified phenyl-to-n-hexyl analogue no-reaction result.

regions.region: page 3 right-column mechanistic discussion and start of Experimental Section
regions.finding: The proposed Path A/Path B narrative was classified as a mechanism record. The start of the 2a typical procedure was merged with Table 3 entry 1 rather than creating a duplicate experiment.

unresolved: TEMPO and Scheme 4 experiments omit absolute scale, workup, purification, or analytical methods.
The n-hexyl negative result does not provide a substrate label, structure, or operating details.
Proposed mechanism intermediates are not isolated.

regions.finding: Two plausible pathways through proposed species A-G and CF3 radical were classified as one mechanism record; the prose observation that 2-iodobenzoic acid was isolated is retained without an invented amount or yield.

regions.region: page 4 left-column completion of the 2a typical procedure
regions.finding: Flame-dried Schlenk tube, argon, 30 °C, TLC, ether/silica-pad workup, NMR analysis, 30:1 petroleum ether/ethyl acetate chromatography, 216.1 mg, and 89% isolated yield were merged with Table 3 entry 1.

The authors thank Youai Qiu for reproducing preparations of 2c, 2g, and 2l. These statements were linked to Table 3 entries 3, 7, and 12 without creating duplicate runs because no independent conditions or outcomes are supplied.

regions.region: page 4 remaining references 1-9 and crystallographic note
regions.finding: Bibliography and CCDC metadata are prior-literature/structure-support context, not additional current-paper reaction experiments.

unresolved: The typical procedure relies on Table 3 for the exact 6 h time.
The reproduction acknowledgement has no separate run identifiers or measurements.
Crystallographic support does not independently verify machine-generated structures.

regions.region: page 5 full rendered page: completion of crystallographic note, references 10-11, and publication dates
regions.finding: The page contains crystallographic metadata, bibliography, and publication dates only. No current-paper reaction arrow, table, procedure, condition, yield, selectivity, or failure result is printed, so no reaction record is assigned to this page.

unresolved: External cited radical/allene literature and CCDC data were not expanded into current-paper experiments.
